    AI Overview
    Rory McIlroy has one child, a daughter named Poppy Kennedy McIlroy, born on August 31, 2020, with his wife, Erica Stoll. Poppy is frequently seen supporting her father at golf events, including the Masters Par 3 Contest, and she is described by McIlroy as the "absolute love of our lives".
    Key details about Rory McIlroy's family:
    • Child: Poppy Kennedy McIlroy (born 2020).
    • Wife: Erica Stoll (married 2017).
    • Family Residence: The family previously lived in Jupiter, Florida, before moving to a home on the Wentworth estate in the UK in 2025.
    • Fatherhood: McIlroy has spoken about how becoming a father has been a profound experience, noting in that it is "the best part of being a human being."
    Poppy Kennedy McIlroy was born at Jupiter Medical Center in Florida.
